full_judgment: 2. The father of the petitioners was owner in possession of the premises situated on a land measuring about .047 acre of C.S. Plot No. 9209 corresponding to S.A. Plot No. 10753F appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 6334 and S.A. Khatian No. 5136 of Mouza, P.S. and District Kishoregonj. The respondent No.3, Sub-Divisional Co-operative Multipurpose Society, Ltd., Kishoregonj took monthly lease of the said premises and started cloth business therein. The respondent No. 3 is a private body engaged in profit earning businesses. It has many buildings at Kishoregonj which have been let out. The respondent No.3 defaulted in the payment, of rent. It also sublet a portion of the demised premises. The present petitioners succeeded to the estate of their father after his death and they needed the demised premises for their own use and occupation. The petitioners instituted O.C. Suit No. 264 of 1975 in the 1st Court of Munsif, Kishoregonj for ejectment of the respondent NO.3 and the suit was decreed on contest on 25.7.78. The petitioners instituted O.C. Execution Case No. 36 of 1978 for khas possession of the demised premises. The respondent No.3 preferred O.C. Appeal No. 216 of 1978 before the learned District Judge, Mymensingh and obtained stay of execution. The appeal was dismissed on 21.3.80. The respondent No.3 obtained a Rule in Civil Revision Case No. 975 of 1980 from the High Court Division and obtained a stay of execution of the Execution case. The Rule was discharged on contest with costs on 19.1.84. The petitioners were taking steps for eviction of the respondent No.3, when suddenly on 15.3.84 they received a notice under Section 6 of the Acquisition and Requisition of Immovable Property Ordinance, 1982 (Ordinance No. II of 1982) for acquisition of the demised land as well as the structures thereon from the office of the Land Acquisition Officer at Mymensingh. On inquiry the petitioners came to know that having failed to resist the decree for eviction, the respondent No. 3 in collusion with the staff of the Land Acquisition Office at Mymensingh started L.A. Case No. 32/81-82 to grab the demised premises by way of acquisition. Notice under Section 3 of the said Ordinance was shown to have been issued on 20.6.83, but the petitioners never received such notice. Before issuance of notice under Section 3 no agreement was entered into by the respondent No.3 with the Government, as mandatorily required under Section 15 of the Ordinance. On 29.3.84 another notice purportedly issued under section 7(3) of the Ordinance was served upon the petitioners. On 1.2.84 Kishoregonj which was a sub-division was elevated to a District. A separate Land Acquisition Office started functioning from the very same date at Kishoregonj, Mymensingh Land Acquisition Office had no jurisdiction to proceed with the disputed property after 1.2.84. But the respondent No.3 got the file of L.A. Case No. 32 of 1981-82 moved in hot haste and some orders were shown to have been passed showing that on 15.3.84 notice under Section 6 of the Ordinance was issued, that on 16.3.84 the said notice was served, that 1.4.84 was fixed for giving formal delivery of possession and that on 2.4.84 certificate of possession was issued in favour of the respondent No.3
